description.value: Priest Valley Arena is a City of Vernon municipal recreation facility primarily serving the local community as a venue for ice hockey and lacrosse. Operated by Vernon's Parks & Recreation department, it is part of the city's broader network of indoor recreation facilities. Cyclists riding through Vernon may encounter it as a landmark or potential rest point, though its core function is as a local indoor sports arena.
